title: Mario & Luigi: Brothership
subtitle: Two brothers reconnect a divided world
summary: Mario & Luigi: Brothership is Acquire's role-playing adventure, released for Nintendo Switch on 7 November 2024.
body: Mario & Luigi: Brothership is Acquire's role-playing adventure, released for Nintendo Switch on 7 November 2024. Mario and Luigi arrive in Concordia, a world whose islands have been separated, and set out to reconnect them. The sixth Mario & Luigi game brings the series to a fully three-dimensional home-console setting. Exploration, comic encounters and turn-based fights remain closely linked to the brothers' teamwork, with separate inputs making both characters active participants in crossing the world and confronting its enemies.

In battle, a correctly timed button press strengthens an attack, while watching an enemy's movement helps the brothers jump over or counter an incoming blow. Bros. Attacks turn that coordination into elaborate shared moves. Battle Plugs add effects that can change a chosen approach to an encounter. The player is making tactical choices and performing them at the same time: selecting a move starts a short sequence whose success depends on understanding the action shown on screen.

Shipshape Island serves as a moving base for exploring Concordia's seas. Reaching another island opens quests and puzzles, and reconnecting it expands the network of places and people linked to the ship. Luigi Logic gives Luigi opportunities to act independently or find a solution during a difficult situation. Hideki Sakamoto composed the score. The voyage builds its sense of reunion through this repeated act of reaching an isolated place, helping its inhabitants and making it part of a larger world again.
